title: Scrambled Copies in a Text
statement:
A text `s` and a word `t` are given. A block of `s` is a scrambled copy of `t` if it has the same length as `t` and its letters can be rearranged to spell `t`. Count the starting positions in `s` where a scrambled copy of `t` begins. Blocks may overlap.

## Input
The first line contains `s`. The second line contains `t`.

## Output
Print the number of positions `i` such that the block of `|t|` letters starting at `i` is a scrambled copy of `t`.

## Constraints
- `1 <= |t| <= |s| <= 95000`
- Both strings contain only lowercase letters `a` to `z`
